shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*lock*'"' -g '"'!dist'"' -g '"'!build'"' -g '"'!*svg'"' -g '"'!*png'"' -g '"'!*jpg'"' | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,78p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md"

/bin/bash -lc "ls -a && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Modal && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg -n -C 2 'navigation|Icons|i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/icons'

/bin/bash -lc "bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button TextInput Select Switch Checkbox Avatar Text Modal && sed -n '1,105p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && rg -n -C 2 'navigation|Icons|i18n' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"

/bin/bash -lc "cat package.json && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json && sed -n '1,140p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md && sed -n '1,65p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/README.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation | rg 'AsideHeader.*(d.ts|README)|docs/INDEX'"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/INDEX.md && sed -n '1,170p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/main.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && rg -n 'Shield|Person|Gear|Bell|ArrowUp|CircleQuestion|Chevron|Check|Envelope|Globe|Lock|ArrowRightFrom|CircleCheck' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'CSS|--g-color|brand' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -90 && rg -n -C 3 'peerDependencies' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 3 'CSS|--gn-|render|logo|width' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md | tail -100; rg -n -C 2 'LogoProps|MenuItem' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | head -75; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -12; rg -n -C 2 'peerDependencies' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/AvatarImage.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/types/common.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; rg -n -C 2 'ControlProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; sed -n '1,105p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '465,510p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n '96,122p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n 'Shield|Person|Gear|Bell|ArrowUpFromLine|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Check|Envelope|Globe|Lock|CircleCheck|ArrowRightFromSquare|CircleInfo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -45; sed -n '117,126p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json; rg -n -- '--gn-aside|--gn-composite' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -30; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/AvatarImage/types.d.ts | head -40"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @bem-react/classname'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'Shield|Person|Gear|Bell|ArrowUpFromLine|CircleQuestion|ChevronDown|ChevronRight|Check|Envelope|Globe|Lock|CircleCheck|CircleInfo' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -35; sed -n '96,120p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; rg -n '"'^## CSS|''^### CSS|gn-aside-header-background|gn-aside-header-size'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; sed -n '117,125p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/package.json"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '535,568p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md; rg -n '"'^export.*(Person|Gear|ShieldCheck|Lock|Globe|ArrowRight)'"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; rg -n -- '--g-text-input|--g-button' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | cut -c 1-250; cat index.html"
/bin/bash -lc "mkdir -p public && curl -L --fail --max-time 20 'https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=200&h=200&fit=crop&crop=faces&auto=format&q=85' -o public/avatar.jpg"

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import urllib.request
try:
 urllib.request.urlretrieve('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=200&h=200&fit=crop&crop=faces&auto=format&q=85','public/avatar.jpg')
 print('Avatar downloaded')
except Exception as e: print(e)
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import {writeFile} from 'node:fs/promises'; const r = await fetch('https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1472099645785-5658abf4ff4e?w=200&h=200&fit=crop&crop=faces&auto=format&q=85'); if ("'!r.ok) throw new Error(r.statusText); await writeFile('"'public/avatar.jpg', Buffer.from(await r.arrayBuffer()));\""

/bin/bash -lc "git diff --stat && rg -n -- '--g-avatar-size|size_xl|size_l' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Avatar/Avatar.css && rg -n -- '--g-spacing-0-5|--g-spacing-10|--g-border-radius-xl' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -10 && sed -n '1,95p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/density.js && rg -n 'renderContent|height|overflow' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components/PageLayout/PageLayout.js && git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "node --input-type=module -e \"import fs from 'node:fs'; const p='src/styles.css'; fs.writeFileSync(p,fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').replace('calc(var(--g-spacing-6) + var(--g-spacing-0-5))','calc(var(--g-spacing-6) + var(--g-spacing-half))')); console.log('Avatar:',fs.statSync('public/avatar.jpg').size,'bytes');\" 
rg -n -- '--g-spacing-half|--g-spacing-0' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build'
